unit: Integrated agentic tool system; finance/public-data media chart review
judgment: Withholds definitive general class; proposed local incremental improvement
retain: System boundary, end-to-end denominator, task-horizon distinction and transparent same-assistant limits
revise: Replace older three-tier formulation with Chapter 11; stop formal scoring after unresolved dissolution rather than presenting scored-looking partial states
dissent: Deferring incremental versus breakthrough remains reasonable without a matched comparator for the defined system.

unit: Integrated agentic tool system; finance/studio chart review
judgment: Provisional bounded breakthrough; no supported Promethean label
retain: Sequential gates, all six NOT SCORED after gate stop, component abstention, posture-only and hype probes
revise: Keep the breakthrough judgment qualified and bounded to evidence; no claim of universal capability discontinuity
dissent: A strict suppression gate must not turn missing historical durability into proof that all emerging potential is impossible.

unit: Deployed generative-AI systems; retail narrative drafting
judgment: Breakthrough capability; conditional long-run Potential hypothesis
retain: Clean one-field posture contrast, careful suppression counterfactual and separation of draft creation from verified outcome
revise: Do not transfer a generative-AI classification to agentic systems; compare under the common unit before synthesis
dissent: Broader generative-AI evidence supports an alternative scope, not direct validation of the narrower common system.

unit: Agentic AI; NYU SPS applicant support with different baselines
judgment: Breakthrough floor with unresolved ceiling and low local significance weight
retain: Separate present finding from future hypothesis, evidence-admissibility distinctions, incremental counterfactual and baseline awareness
revise: Do not infer field 10X or tier reorganization from benchmark ratios, exposure, uptake or forecasts; no prospective scoring that looks like a passed gate
dissent: Strong capability trajectories could justify more attention before mature dependence exists; the framework should not ignore that possibility.
